reviewer: Codex implement_evidence; independent full read after terminal transcription
method: Read all 120 literal source strings and every contract fact, scope, intent, presentation item and origin pointer. Compare meaning with pinned Mermaid syntax documentation/grammar text. Static extraction authenticates provenance only; neither extraction nor generator equality supplies semantic review. No renderer, Mermaid parser, candidate/reference output or renderer AST was invoked to define expected answers.

Generic declaration Box~T~ used as class identity instead of canonical Box plus generic parameter T.

State/ER global or default direction is required; it must be a declared advisory rather than universal topology geometry.
Duplicate subgraph mention follows bounded first-declaration ownership; later bare references do not transfer nodes.

qualification: Source-expectation review is complete for the exact admitted semantic hashes. This supplies no output-correctness, observer-completeness or performance qualification.
